name: CoQA
description: Conversational question answering dataset with about 127k turns. QuAC (Choi et al., TACL 2018) is a related conversational QA dataset with about 100k turns. Data sources may have distinct terms; no data is vendored in this record.
citation: CoQA: A Conversational Question Answering Challenge. Reddy et al., Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics (TACL), 2019.
